selected_evidence.requirement: Sign the host key with the authority
selected_evidence.summary: The signed certificate matches the active ED25519 host key, identifies the new RSA CA, and contains node1 and 10.100.255.10 as principals.

selected_evidence.requirement: Have sshd present the signed host certificate
selected_evidence.summary: The candidate configuration passed sshd validation; after installation and reload, sshd was active and its effective configuration showed /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub.

selected_evidence.requirement: Prove a CA-trusting client connects without pinning the host key
selected_evidence.summary: Not proven: the first client test could not execute because the Harbor control connection returned exit 255 immediately after the sshd reload.

Baseline boot ID was 1a816f1f-858b-4487-af28-54070d4ce684 with sshd active and enabled. No reboot was issued because command execution was unavailable; therefore there is no restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, or post-restart recovery proof.
